messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — need to decide final cuts for milestone 3. Infra perf regression (incident #842) pushed our latency SLOs. Propose moving 'prompt-store autosave' and 'multitenant routing' to v1. Keep core hosted API + telemetry + SSO for MVP. Thoughts?
Miguel (Eng): Confirmed incident impact. We can keep telemetry and SSO as they are infra-light. Prompt-store autosave is expensive (KV+cache + KV eviction/rate limiting), needs ~2 sprint work. +1 to defer.
Priya (Design): UX for prompt-store is half-baked; deferring reduces risk and surfaces fewer edge-cases for pilots. Need commitment to do a proper flows pass in v1.
Jordan (Sales): A couple of pilot customers (Acme & Talon) asked for autosave. If we cut it, we should offer a manual-export workaround and a feature-flagged beta for them.
Sasha (CTO): Agree on cutting autosave from MVP. Also: legal signoff required for telemetry retention. Loop Legal. We should also add a runtime fallback (model-variant routing) in case latency spikes on day 1.
Devin (PMM): Marketing needs a clean launch checklist — if autosave is out, we must not claim ‘auto-recovery’ in docs or banners. Also want a short FAQ for pilot customers.
Legal: Please attach data retention policy doc link and DPA excerpt. Without that we can't approve telemetry for external pilot. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/data-retention.legal
Ava (PM): Proposed milestone plan update:
- MVP target: 2026-04-15 -> hosted API, SSO, basic telemetry (bounded retention), docs, SDKs, pilot program
- v1 target: 2026-06-10 -> prompt-store autosave, advanced routing (multitenant), Dedicated capacity beta
Anyone object?
Miguel (Eng): Timeline looks tight given incident. Recommend shifting MVP by +1 week for perf tuning: MVP -> 2026-04-22. That gives dev + QA a buffer.
Priya (Design): +1 week is fine, gives us time for final accessibility pass.
Jordan (Sales): OK, will communicate new date to pilots and adjust expectations; will ask Acme if they want beta feature-flag access for autosave.
Sasha (CTO): Approved. Add a 72h rollback and automated fallback to compatible model-variant if latency > SLO. Also require an infra playbook in the runbook.
Ava (PM): Action items (I’ll update RD-3421 and release notes):
- @miguel: update perf tickets (#RD-3498, #RD-3501) and confirm ETA
- @legal: review telemetry retention & DPA by EOD Tue
- @jordan: update pilot comms and offer feature-flagged beta to Acme/Talon
- @devin: lock marketing messaging and FAQ
- @pri: prepare a short v1 UX brief for autosave (due next Wed)
Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Incident #842 resolved; hotfix rollback completed 12:30 UTC.
